goal: Implement one bounded feature in the current project.
context: Summarize the relevant behavior, files, and prior decisions. Replace this example with task-specific context.
constraints: Do not add dependencies unless explicitly authorized.
expected_files_or_subsystems: Name the expected files or subsystems; do not use an unrestricted placeholder.
acceptance_criteria: Add or update deterministic tests for the requested behavior.
non_goals: Do not implement adjacent roadmap features.
stop_condition: Stop when the requested behavior, acceptance criteria, and final verification are complete.
escalation_evidence: Escalate only after documenting a reproducible blocker, attempted focused remedies, and why the remaining work exceeds this model.
